title: Curated Earnings Intelligence Company Coverage Record
description: One row of companies.json. Describes the curated-research coverage state for a single project stock symbol. This record never contains promise/outcome content itself -- that lives in promises/<SYMBOL>.json. A symbol with no override here still gets a synthesized RESEARCH_PENDING record from CuratedEarningsIntelligenceService, derived from the authoritative SUPPORTED_STOCKS list in utils/constants.js.

symbol.description: Must match a key in SUPPORTED_STOCKS exactly (uppercase).

coverageStart.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the earliest covered reporting period.

lastVerifiedAt.description: ISO date the curator last reviewed the underlying promise records against official sources.
